question: Which of the following animals is made to race in the traditional sport called 'Kambala' in Karnataka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Buffalo**__.

__
 
• **Buffalo is made to race in the traditional sport called 'Kambala' in Karnataka.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kambala**:

 
 
• Buffaloes and their owners participate in the traditional Kambala race.
 
• The race takes place in the coastal districts of **Dakshina Kannada and Udupi of Karnataka **and K**asaragod of Kerala and north Kerala from November to March**. 
 
• The sport is sponsored by local **Tuluva landlords and households.**
 
• Kambala racetrack is mostly a **slushy paddy field**, and the buffaloes are driven by a whip-lashing farmer.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24f4204134869619482906018074a1a15a1a92eb001b31cb050aa14984c1cca7.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jalikattu**:

 
 
• The sport is also known as **eru thazhuvuthal.**
 
• **Bulls **are being used in this sport and the format of track and race remains the same.
